problem_statement: The Bedimcode responsive headphones landing page is a single-page product marketing site, already rebranded to the fictional Lumen Audio "Halo One" open-back studio headphone (hero wordmark/overview, Acoustics specs, Travel case, Products grid, footer). Build out and wire the Acoustics section's product FINISH EXPLORER so it works end to end across the whole page. Specifically: (1) the explorer pairs a live product photo of the Halo One (the actual headphone image) with a spec panel of four tiles (Finish / THD / Impedance / Response); the spec tiles must reflow cleanly and the photo must sit beside the panel without overlapping or clipping it at desktop, tablet and 390px mobile, with no horizontal overflow; (2) the 'Choose your finish' swatch row (Copper / Defiant / Marine / Champagne Edition) must be a real interaction -- clicking a finish swatch swaps the shown product photo to that finish's headphone, updates the Finish tile and the 'Now showing' caption, and updates the finish readout to the chosen finish and its note, never leaving a stale photo or label; (3) the shared 'Two-year assurance' rail is a cross-section component that must appear consistently in the Acoustics, Travel case AND footer sections. Preserve the dark Lumen palette, Poppins rhythm, rounded card surfaces, the fixed header + anchor nav, the mobile menu, the sponsor strip, the scroll-up control, the local product images, and the static (no-build) delivery. The result must read as one finished single-brand landing page whose finish explorer, swatch interaction and assurance rail all behave correctly -- not a version where the product photo crashes over the spec panel, the tiles overflow on mobile, the chosen finish shows the wrong (stale) headphone, or the assurance rail only appears in one section.
required_content: The Acoustics finish explorer pairs a live Halo One product photo with a four-tile spec panel (Finish, THD @ 1kHz, Impedance, Response); the photo sits beside the panel without overlapping or clipping it, and the tile row stays inside the viewport at desktop, tablet and 390px mobile with no horizontal overflow.

The 'Choose your finish' swatch row is a real interaction: clicking the Copper / Defiant / Marine / Champagne Edition swatch marks it active AND swaps the shown product photo, the Finish tile, the 'Now showing' caption and the finish readout to the chosen finish.
The shared 'Two-year assurance' rail appears consistently in the Acoustics, Travel case, and footer sections (a section-modifier component, not a one-off).
The rebranded Acoustics facts (Open-back 45mm, Copper Edition, 'measured on the same rig'), the Travel case 'moulded hard case' copy, and the Products finish names remain coherent and on-brand.
The fixed header, Home/Specs/Case/Products anchor nav, mobile menu, sponsor strip, scroll-up control, footer subscription form, and local images remain present and working.
The page continues to serve statically directly from index.html with no package install or build step.
design_constraints: Preserve the dark Lumen palette, Poppins typographic scale, rounded surfaces, compact spacing, white text and subtle shadows; the finish explorer photo stage, spec tiles, swatch row and assurance rail must match the surrounding card/shadow language and stay legible.
Do not turn the site into a dashboard, SaaS site, or generic feature grid; it must remain a single-product landing page and the explorer must stay tied to the actual Halo One product photos.

Use the existing index.html structure, assets/css/styles.css, assets/js/main.js and assets/js/interactive.js, and the local assets/img product images; do not add external stock imagery, CDNs, or icon packs beyond what ships in the repo.
Keep the site static and buildless: it must continue to serve directly from index.html with no install or build step.
Remote font/icon/script dependencies (Poppins, RemixIcon, ScrollReveal) are localized into the repo as identical infrastructure across all solution variants and are not part of the graded surface.
state_constraints: desktop_initial / mobile_initial protect the rebranded hero and single-page shell across viewports.
desktop_specs / mobile_specs / tablet_specs verify the finish explorer layout: the product photo beside a legible spec panel with no overlap/clip and no-overflow reflow.

desktop_finish_default / desktop_finish_marine verify the finish selector interaction (the shown product photo, Finish tile, 'Now showing' caption and readout all switch from Copper to the clicked finish).
desktop_case / desktop_footer verify the cross-section assurance rail; desktop_products verifies the finish-named products grid; mobile_menu_open verifies the mobile nav.

change_completion: The finish explorer renders the live product photo, the four spec tiles and the finish swatch row, with the assurance rail present in the Acoustics section.

The finish selector swaps the shown product photo and updates the Finish tile, 'Now showing' caption and readout to the clicked finish (Copper -> Marine), and the products grid uses the on-brand finish names.
design_consistency: The explorer photo stage, spec tiles, finish swatches and assurance rail reuse the dark Lumen palette, Poppins type, rounded surfaces and shadow language, stay legible, and the photo does not collide with the spec panel.
The shared assurance rail appears consistently across the Acoustics, case and footer sections (a cross-section component), not just in one place.
responsive: The finish explorer spec tiles stay inside the viewport at desktop, tablet and 390px mobile with no horizontal overflow (tolerance 24px).
The photo stage, spec tiles, finish swatches and assurance rail reflow cleanly across the three viewports without overlap or clipping.
regression: The existing Home/Specs/Case/Products anchors, buttons, product cards, footer form, mobile menu and scroll-up remain present and keep working after the change.
The page continues to serve statically directly from the existing index.html with no package install or build step, and every original section remains intact.

metadata.design_goal: Build and correctly wire the Acoustics product finish explorer (live product photo + legible spec panel, a finish selector that swaps the shown headphone, and a cross-section assurance rail) on a rebranded single-page product landing, preserving its design system, interactions and static delivery.
metadata.source_repo_kind: Static one-page headphones product marketing site with local hero/specs/case/discount/product/sponsor images, fixed nav anchors, mobile menu JS, scroll header, scroll-up control, and product purchase sections.
metadata.selected_repo_reason: Unused runnable static marketing repo whose every section (hero/specs/case/discount/products/footer) is placeholder demo content for a generic Beats 3 headphone, making it a natural cross-page restyle: rebrand the whole page into one coherent fictional product while keeping the polished layout, dark palette, anchor nav, mobile menu, and no-build static delivery.

author_notes: Slot slot_265 (Edit / regression_continuity / restyle, cross_page) rebuilt to a native product finish explorer at L4. Reference = correct explorer: a live Halo One product photo sits beside a legible spec panel (Finish/THD/Impedance/Response tiles wrap, 0 overflow), the finish swatches swap the shown headphone photo + Finish tile + 'Now showing' caption + readout, and the assurance rail is present in Acoustics+case+footer. baseline = the original layout defect: the spec tile row is a fixed 760px nowrap track (mobile overflow ~709px) restyled off-brand light cream, and the assurance rail was only propagated to the Acoustics section (missing from case+footer) -- fails D6 no_horizontal_overflow, D3 visual_regression and D2 cross-section dom_assertions, but its finish selector still wires correctly so it PASSES D4. bad = a 'smart' error where the explorer is genuinely broken: the product photo is torn out of flow, oversized and absolutely positioned so it CRASHES over the spec panel (the Finish tile is occluded), the tiles are a washed-out light-on-light panel that is illegible and overlap on a still-too-wide 720px nowrap track (mobile overflow ~480px), the assurance rail is again only in Acoustics, AND a stale-closure finish selector toggles the active swatch on click (real, succeeded interaction) but only ever re-writes the photo/caption/tile/readout from the captured initial 'Copper Edition' values -- so the chosen finish shows the WRONG headphone. It FAILS four orthogonal gates: no_horizontal_overflow (D6), visual_regression (D3), dom_assertions (D2 cross-section), and interaction_assertions (D4 stale product + readout). Product-grade gates: enforce_console_errors (max 0, 11 states, all legs runtime-clean) + visual_regression (pixelmatch 0.08/tol30, ssim 0.85, block_fidelity 0.8/deltaE15 on desktop/mobile/tablet specs) + interaction_assertions (finish readout + 'Now showing' caption delta) + cross-section dom_assertions + no_horizontal_overflow (tol 24). Remote Poppins + RemixIcon + ScrollReveal are localized into the repo as identical infrastructure across all three legs; ScrollReveal reveals are neutralized (no-op) so no animation-driven phantom overflow, and .main{overflow:hidden} plus the decorative off-canvas specs/discount images are contained as identical infrastructure so real overflow is measurable.
